description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 3 August 2018, the second of the enhanced packs built around particular types, here Grass, Psychic and Fairy. Alolan Ninetales-GX leads it: its Ability fetches two Item cards from the deck when it is played from the hand to evolve, and its GX attack knocks out an Active Ultra Beast outright. Sceptile-GX, Sigilyph-GX and Mimikyu-GX join it, with Prism Star Xerneas and Life Forest. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 50, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Morty and Mina, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Net Ball, Adventure Bag and Spell Tag. In English many of its cards came out in Lost Thunder in November 2018.
